title: That's Not Nice (2)
subtitle: Idioms for being betrayed, abandoned, and underestimated.

idioms.ex: I told him my secret plan, and he **sold me down the river** to the boss.

idioms.mean: leave someone without help when they need it
idioms.ex: My group members didn't come, and they **left me high and dry** with the whole presentation.

idioms.mean: think someone is less good or able than they really are
idioms.ex: Don't **sell yourself short**. You can win this competition!

tip: **sell yourself short** sangat sering dipakai untuk menyemangati: *Don't sell yourself short!* (jangan meremehkan dirimu). Bentuk lampau: *sold*, *left*.

options: take someone on a boat trip
put someone in a high place

dialogue.q: A: I trusted Dani with our plan, but he told everything to the other team! B: Wow, he really ___.
dialogue.why: Pengkhianatan → sold you down the river.

dialogue.q: A: The driver took my money and drove away. I was alone in the middle of nowhere! B: He ___!
dialogue.why: Ditinggal tanpa bantuan → left you high and dry.

dialogue.q: A: I'm not smart enough to apply for that scholarship. B: Don't ___! Your grades are great.
dialogue.why: Meremehkan diri sendiri → sell yourself short.

correct.q: "My best friend sold me down the river by helping me study."
"The band cancelled an hour before the wedding and left us high and dry."
"Everyone sold her short, but she became the top student."
correct.why: Benar: orang meremehkan, ternyata dia hebat.

correct.q: "He left me high and dry by driving me home after the party."

speak.q: Has anyone ever left you high and dry? What did you do?
speak.model: Yes, last semester my partner disappeared a day before our deadline. He <mark>left me high and dry</mark>, so I stayed up all night and finished the project alone.
speak.label: leave someone high and dry

speak.q: Do you sometimes sell yourself short? In what situations?
speak.model: Sometimes I <mark>sell myself short</mark> when I speak English. I think my English is bad, but my friends say I'm actually quite fluent.
speak.label: sell someone short

speak.q: How would you feel if a friend sold you down the river?
speak.model: I would feel terrible. If a close friend <mark>sold me down the river</mark>, I don't think I could trust them again.
speak.label: sell someone down the river

roleplay.situation: Kalian satu kelompok tugas. Satu anggota tidak datang di hari presentasi dan malah bilang ke dosen bahwa kalian yang malas.
steps: **Student A:** ceritakan bahwa temanmu tidak datang (*He left us high and dry*).
**Student B:** tambahkan bahwa dia malah menyalahkan kalian ke dosen (*He sold us down the river*).
**Student A:** bilang kamu tidak yakin bisa presentasi sendiri.
**Student B:** semangati temanmu (*Don't sell yourself short!*) dan bagi tugasnya.
roleplay.target: Target: percakapan 1–2 menit, semua 3 idiom terpakai.
